objective: Compute (1) per-year mean/std of danceability, energy, valence for 2017/2018/2020 popular songs, (2) one-way ANOVA across the three years for each feature, (3) HHI of the video-game publisher market, (4) mean/median of book and movie ratings; write all results to output.json.

final_artifact.encoding: UTF-8 JSON object, full float precision (json.dump default double repr), no NaN/Infinity allowed

cleaning: coerce 3 feature cols to numeric, drop NaN if any (expected 0)
inputs.group_note: 100 distinct tracks, one row per track

cleaning: column order differs from 2017/2018 (energy before danceability) -> select by name, never by position
Publisher has 58 NaN rows (0.17% of Global_Sales) -> drop them from both numerator and denominator (primary definition)
Strip whitespace on Publisher before grouping

Quoting is broken on 4 physical lines (lines 3350, 4704, 5879, 8981 -> 13 fields instead of 12) caused by an unquoted comma inside authors; parse with csv.reader and repair by merging fields[2] and fields[3] into authors when len(row)==13
Header has a space-padded name '  num_pages' (strip column names)
average_rating: coerce to float; expected 11127 rows, 0 missing, no duplicate bookID
MUST use usecols to avoid parsing the dirty 'id'/'popularity' columns (33 MB file)
pd.to_numeric(..., errors='coerce'); drop rows with NaN vote_average -> expected n=45460
Do NOT drop vote_average==0 in the primary definition (they are genuine 0-vote/unknown-rated rows); reported separately as sensitivity

steps.description: For each year file and each feature: mean (arithmetic, pandas Series.mean) and standard deviation with sample correction ddof=1 (pandas default). Emit keys '{feature}_{year}_mean' and '{feature}_{year}_std'.
steps.decisions: ddof=1 is chosen (pandas/scipy default, consistent with data_profile.json 'values_ddof1'); ddof=0 values exist in the profile as an alternate but are NOT used.

steps.description: One-way ANOVA across the three independent year groups for each of the 3 features via scipy.stats.f_oneway(g2017, g2018, g2020).
steps.formula: F = MS_between / MS_within, df=(k-1=2, N-k=247); two-sided p from the F(2,247) survival function
checks: significance level alpha=0.05 for interpretation only

steps.description: Group vgsales by Publisher, sum Global_Sales, compute market shares over the total, HHI = sum(share_i^2).
steps.formula: share_i = S_i / sum(S); HHI = sum_i share_i^2 (0-1 scale)

alternatives_to_report_in_notes_only.missing_publisher_as_Unknown: treat NaN Publisher as one extra group -> 0.079044 (robustness, not the primary value)

steps.description: books: mean/median of books.average_rating (n=11127). movies: mean/median of movies.vote_average over non-null rows (n=45460).
steps.formula: arithmetic mean; median = numpy linear-interpolated 50th percentile
steps.output: ratings (4 floats: books_mean, books_median, movies_mean, movies_median)

steps.description: Assemble the 4 top-level objects into output.json, validate schema, then finish.

validation_rules: music_features has exactly 18 keys, all values Python float (round-trip float(x))
anova has exactly 6 keys, all values float, both 0 <= p_value <= 1 and f_statistic >= 0
ratings has exactly 4 keys, book values within [0,5], movie values within [0,10]
no NaN / Infinity in the JSON (check json.dumps(..., allow_nan=False))
cross-check every value against the upstream data_profile.json reference values with abs tolerance 1e-6; a mismatch means a parsing bug, not a new result
expected_findings: Danceability is flat across years (0.697 / 0.716 / 0.717) and not significantly different (p~0.49).
Energy declines monotonically 0.661 -> 0.659 -> 0.609 and has the smallest p-value (~0.089) but still misses alpha=0.05.
All ANOVA p-values > 0.05 -> no year-over-year trend in these audio features at 5% level; report this honestly rather than claiming a trend.
Game market HHI ~0.079 (792.9 on 0-10000 scale) = highly unconcentrated, driven by Nintendo (~20%) and EA (~12.5%).
Books average_rating mean 3.93 < median 3.96 (left-skewed); movies vote_average mean 5.62 < median 6.0, and the 2998 zero-vote rows pull the mean down (6.00/6.1 if restricted to vote_count>0).
expected_findings_note: These are hypotheses carried over from the upstream data_profile.json (already computed there); they must be independently re-verified from the raw files during execution and must not be copied without recomputation.
risks: 2020 group has n=50 (half of the other groups) -> unbalanced design; f_oneway handles unbalanced groups but power differs; mention unequal n when reporting.
Using ddof=0 instead of ddof=1 changes std only in the 3rd decimal; the ddof=1 convention must be stated in the report.
If movies rows with vote_average==0 are excluded, movie mean/median shift materially -> definitions must be documented with the reported numbers.
books.csv cannot be read safely with a naive pd.read_csv (4 ragged rows); use the merge-fix parser.
HHI depends on the missing-Publisher handling: dropping (0.07929) vs 'Unknown' bucket (0.07904) - document the choice.

execution_notes.runtime_budget: single run_python call under 120s is sufficient; movies_metadata.csv reads in a few seconds with usecols+low_memory=False
